name: Kakoli Ghosh

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Kakoli Ghosh writes poetry in English and Bengali and also paints. Published under her name and as ‘Moon Drops’, her work appears in literary journals and international anthologies. GloMag’s contributor note identifies her collections Unfinished and The Bridge, connecting the poet’s literary work with her interest in visual art.

In Kabita Live, her poems give loneliness and memory a physical presence. ‘The Water Of Life’ draws on distilling, bottles and wine stains to explore grief that outlasts attempts to contain it. ‘Slipping into something else’ moves through emptied spaces, ripening fields, flooded nests and bodily images, making change feel at once intimate and unsettling.
